profile.bio: Full-stack .NET developer with over three years of experience building and modernizing production systems in regulated and public-sector environments. Strong background in ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, and legacy-to-modern migrations, with hands-on experience in event-driven design and Azure deployments. I focus on writing maintainable code, designing clear architectural boundaries, and building systems that remain robust as they grow in complexity.
